content.text: I'll explore the owner creation code to trace the validations and side-effects.

Here is the complete ordered trace of `addOwner` (the handler for `POST /api/owners`, `OwnerRestControllerV1.java:142-244`), listing each validation (V) and side-effect (S) in the exact order they execute.

## Before the method body

1. **(V) Authorization** — `@PreAuthorize("hasRole(@roles.OWNER_ADMIN)")` (line 117/142): caller must hold the `OWNER_ADMIN` role, else the request is rejected before any logic runs.
2. **(V) Bean Validation of the request body** — the generated `OwnersApi` contract validates the incoming `OwnerFieldsDto` (`@Valid`) before the method is entered; any constraint violations on the DTO fields are rejected here.

## Inside the method body (in order)

3. **(S) Map DTO → entity** — `ownerMapper.toOwner(ownerFieldsDto)` builds the `Owner` (line 146).
4. **(S) Default the registration date** — if `registrationDate` is null, set it to `LocalDate.now()` (lines 147-149).
5. **(V) Registration date not in the future** — if the (supplied) registration date is after today → **400 Bad Request** (lines 151-153).
6. **(S) Roll registration date to a business day** — `toBusinessDay(...)`: Saturday → +2, Sunday → +1, weekday unchanged (line 154).
7. **(V) Per-day volume cap** — count existing owners already registered on that (rolled) date; if `>= 100` → **429 Too Many Requests** (lines 155-162).
8. **(S) Normalize address** — `addressNormalizer.normalize(...)` (line 163).
9. **(V) Address not blank** — if the normalized address is blank → **400** (lines 164-166).
10. **(S) Store normalized address** — `owner.setAddress(address)` (line 167).
11. **(S) Normalize telephone** — `telephoneNormalizer.normalize(...)` (line 168).
12. **(V) Telephone present/parseable** — if normalized telephone is null → **400** (lines 169-171).
13. **(V) Telephone national-number length** — if `!hasValidNationalNumberLength(...)` → **400** (lines 172-174).
14. **(S) Store normalized telephone** — `owner.setTelephone(telephone)` (line 175).
15. **Email handling (only if email is non-null)** (lines 176-187):
    - **(S)** trim the email;
    - **(V)** if it doesn't match `EMAIL_PATTERN` → **400**;
    - **(V)** if its domain is in `DISPOSABLE_EMAIL_DOMAINS` (mailinator/tempmail/guerrillamail, case-insensitive) → **400**;
    - **(S)** store the email lower-cased.
16. **Postcode handling (only if postcode is non-null)** (lines 191-197):
    - **(V)** if it isn't exactly 4 digits (`POSTCODE_PATTERN`) **or** isn't valid for the owner's city (`cityRegionResolver.isPostcodeValidForCity`) → **400**.
17. **(S) Assign household id** — `owner.setHouseholdId(householdResolver.householdId(owner))`, deterministic from normalized last name + postcode (line 203).
18. **(V) Household-duplicate rule** — if the household already exists **and** the `sharesHousehold` flag is not true → **409 Conflict** (lines 204-212).
19. **(V) Hard duplicate (identity key)** — `isDuplicateOwner(owner)`: if any existing owner has the same `identityKey` (normalized telephone | email | householdId) → **409** (lines 213-215).
20. **(V) Per-city cap** — count existing owners in the same normalized city; if `>= 50` → **409** (lines 216-222).
21. **(S) Set customer code** — `customerCode(owner)` = `<REGION>-<HASH8>` (region from postcode/city + SHA-256 prefix of telephone+lastName) (line 223).
22. **(S) Set namesake count** — number of existing owners sharing first+last name, case-insensitive (line 224).
23. **(S) Set membership number** — `<customerCode>-M<YY>` from the registration year (line 225).
24. **(S) Set bulk-signup warning** — `true` if more than 80 owners already registered that day (line 226).
25. **(S) Compute & set soft-duplicate flags** — unless it's a declared household member, `possibleDuplicateOf(owner)` finds an existing owner with the same normalized last name + same postcode but a different telephone (lowest id); then `setPossibleDuplicate(...)` and `setPossibleDuplicateOf(...)` (lines 233-235).
26. **(S) Persist the owner** — `clinicService.saveOwner(owner)` (line 236).
27. **(S) Audit log** — `AUDIT.info(...)` emits an audit line with id, customerCode, registrationDate, and derived membership level (lines 237-239).
28. **(S) Build response** — map to `OwnerDto`, set the `Location` header to `/api/owners/{id}`, return **201 Created** (lines 240-243).

### Notes on ordering
- The validations short-circuit in this exact sequence, so the **first** failing check determines the response status — e.g. a future registration date (400) is reported before the per-day cap (429), which is reported before any address/telephone/email/postcode checks.
- Several side-effects mutate the entity **before** later validations run (address, telephone, email, householdId are all normalized/set before the duplicate and city-cap checks), and the rate-limit counts at steps 7 and 24 are both derived from `ownersCreatedThatDay` captured at step 7.
